pending_reason: Only these two explicit shroud-response scenarios reach a late storm-copy path under the scripted pending-spell lifecycle. Gilded Light is cast after the original Tendrils cast; the original therefore has zero preceding spells for storm. Current resolution instead requests additional player targets. No completed rules-assertion outcome exists and these harness failures must not enter a known-failure baseline.

source_evidence.detail: Tendrils exposes QUERY_STORM to the shared casting implementation.
put_card_on_stack3 queries storm, obtains the current get_storm_count at line2748 and creates copies at line2753; the observed extra target requests occur after casting the response.
resolve_response restores the parent context and drains response plus parent; no single-top response lifecycle is available to this authoring pass.

resolution_policy: Preserve both controllers and original zero-prior-spell Oracle assertions. Review lifecycle/timing and validate without unscripted choices on both runtimes before promotion. This archive makes no observer, API or gameplay change.
